title: About Wing Cut Over Shale Bloom
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 310 recent saved-signal files and 267 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Anchor image material 2 and Anchor image material 3, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Wing Cut Over Shale Bloom: Cinematic still, concrete camera plate grammar: a 16:9 botanical-shale threshold with wide soft green negative space left and a hero wing-and-orange-bloom event just right of center. Keep pale editorial rule masses on the left as illegible stacked bars, black panoramic slits at top and bottom, twig mesh cutting diag... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against pale butterfly wing and rim speckles, orange bud mound, and shale and bark foreground slope.
